interpretation: Safe-to-push means the public source tree is clean, push wrappers are no-op safe, and guardrails are present. It does not mean the legal product is GA-shipped; Passes 48-51 still require external attorney sandbox, limited real-matter pilot, release-candidate signoff, and GA shipment signoff evidence.
